title: China adds data and algorithms to its trade secret rules, as part of Beijing's efforts to prevent tech leaks amid intensifying strategic competition with the US (Nectar Gan/Bloomberg)
summary: Nectar Gan / Bloomberg: China adds data and algorithms to its trade secret rules, as part of Beijing's efforts to prevent tech leaks amid intensifying strategic competition with the US — China expanded its trade secret rules to include data and algorithms, as Beijing steps up efforts to prevent technology leaks …
